_body: Axis position display. Softkeys pick the set:
MACH - machine (home) coordinates
ABS  - work coordinates (active WCS + tool)
REL  - relative counter (zeroable, display only)
TOGO - distance remaining in current move
ALL  - all four sets at once
(OPRT):
ORIGIN - zero the relative counter, all axes
PRESET - set relative counter to typed value
PTSPRE - reset parts counter (CAN / EXEC)
Loaded program; executing line in red.
Arrows / PgUp / PgDn scroll the view.
(OPRT):
O SRH  - load a typed O-number from the
program directory
N SRH  - move view to a typed N-number
SRH v / SRH ^ - find typed text down / up
REWIND - move view to the top
Edit the loaded program (not while running).
Up/Down = line cursor, Left/Right = word cursor.
Softkeys:
INSERT  - add typed word(s) after the word
(RETURN adds a new line)
ALTER   - replace the selected word
DEL.WRD - delete the selected word
ALT.LIN - replace the whole line
DEL.LIN - delete the whole line
N SRH / SRH v / SRH ^ - search the buffer
SAVE    - write file, reload (CAN / EXEC)
CANCEL  - discard edits
Physical INSERT / ALTER / DELETE act on the word.
Type one block; run with EXEC or ENTER.
Needs machine on, out of E-stop.
Words auto-space (M3S1000 -> M3 S1000).
CLEAR empties the block history.
Program text with live position and
distance-to-go.
ABS / REL switch the position block.
Executing block split into words, with the
live modal G/M state alongside.
Next physical block with live modal state.
Read-ahead may already be further along.
Run-from-line. Type an N-number or raw line
number, then SEARCH.
The scan shows the tool, spindle, feed, coolant
and modal state that would be active there.
M/S/T are NOT run on the way in: re-establish
tool, spindle and coolant by MDI, then EXEC.
Restart into a subroutine is blocked.
Browse the machine program directory.
RETURN / SELECT opens a folder or loads a file.
(OPRT):
SELECT - load file / enter folder
O SRH  - move cursor to a typed O-number
NEW    - create <name>.ngc
PUNCH  - copy file to the first USB
DELETE - delete file (CAN / EXEC)
REFRSH - re-read the directory
Browse a mounted USB drive.
(OPRT):
SELECT - load file / enter folder
O SRH  - move cursor to a typed O-number
NEW    - create <name>.ngc
READ   - copy file into machine memory
DELETE - delete file (CAN / EXEC)
REFRSH - re-read the drive
Tool length (Z), radius and comment per tool.
WEAR / GEOM pick the table; applied = geom + wear.
(OPRT):
NO.SRH - jump to a typed tool number
MEASUR - type Z<ref>; length = current Z - ref
INP.C. - copy relative counter into the field
+INPUT - add typed value to the field
INPUT  - set the field to the typed value
CLEAR  - clear ALL / WEAR / GEOM
READ / PUNCH - reload / save the tool table
PROBE opens the tool-length probe page.
DISPLAY UNITS - how linear values are shown:
MACHINE   - native machine units
MM / INCH - forced
PROGRAM   - follow the program G20/G21
Type a name, or INPUT to cycle. Persists.
Rotary axes are never converted.
Work systems G54-G59.3; active one marked *.
Values are per axis.
(OPRT):
NO.SRH - jump to a system number (1-9)
MEASUR - type axis+value; current position
becomes that reading in the system
+INPUT - add the typed value
INPUT  - set the typed value
PROBE opens the part-probe pages.
Measures tool length on the fixed sensor.
Sensor position and feeds come from
[TOOLSENSOR] in the ini.
Z ZERO HEIGHT - the only per-cycle field:
sensor face to your intended Z zero.
Position over the sensor, then Z.PRB (CAN / EXEC).
Set work offsets by touching the part. Pages:
OUT   - outside edges and corners
IN    - inside walls and corners
ANGLE - edge angle (measures rotation)
BOSS  - round/rect boss and pocket centers
RIDGE - ridge and valley centers
CAL   - calibrate stylus on a known gauge
3x3 grid: green = feature, red = start,
purple = motion; centre cell is a Z touch.
Arrows pick the cell. Result writes the ACTIVE WCS.
Clearances and feeds are on P.SET.
Position the probe, then EXEC.
Shared probe parameters for every cycle:
clearances, step-off, probe feeds, calibration
offset, and boss/pocket/gauge size hints.
Type a value and INPUT. Persists.
Machine configuration: ini file, joint count,
kinematics type.
EXIT closes the interface (CAN / EXEC).
Active alarms (red) and cleared history.
RESET (ESC) or CLEAR moves active alarms
to history. Machine faults re-raise until fixed.
2D toolpath preview. Feed = per-tool colors,
rapids dim blue, executed path grays out live.
Marker = tool tip; orange line = A/C tool axis.
Softkeys: XY / XZ / YZ / ISO views, ZOOM,
pan arrows, FIT, REDRAW (clear the trace).
No help for this page yet.
Press any softkey to close.
